import pandas as pd
df = pd.read_csv('data.csv')
df['date'] = pd.to_datetime(df['date'])
acct = df[df.account_id=='49tAGZz']
# check for any new rows on 10-13 not present earlier, and price changes
piv = acct.pivot_table(index=['csp','cloud_service','application','instance_family'], columns='date', values=['price','num_instances'])
changes = []
for idx, row in acct.groupby(['csp','cloud_service','application','instance_family']):
    r = row.sort_values('date')
    if r['price'].nunique()>1 or r['num_instances'].nunique()>1:
        changes.append((idx, r[['date','price','num_instances']].to_string()))
print(len(changes))
for c in changes[:5]:
    print(c[0]); print(c[1][:800])

import pandas as pd
df = pd.read_csv('data.csv')
df['date'] = pd.to_datetime(df['date'])
acct = df[df.account_id=='49tAGZz']
# check whether any resource's share of app/service total changed on 10-13 (hidden offsetting changes)
sub = acct[(acct.cloud_service=='Sj2f9')&(acct.application=='9fC')]
piv = sub.pivot_table(index='instance_family', columns='date', values='unblended_cost')
tot = piv.sum(axis=0)
share = piv.div(tot, axis=1).T
diffs = share.diff().abs().max()
print(diffs.sort_values(ascending=False).head())
